info.title: artka.dev Content API
info.description: Versioned ingestion of finished Markdown articles. Draft by default. Publication is asynchronous. See docs/content-api.md.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Admin session cookie (administrators only; named __Secure-better-auth.session_token in production). Used only when no Authorization header is sent. Non-GET requests must carry an Origin header equal to the site origin. No rate limit.
